titleEn: One Piece of Cheese, a Whole Bowl of Dinner!

pages.text: "More cheese! One piece is too small!" Pipo stamped by the cheese shelf. Mom cut him a piece. "Only one before dinner." He was already swallowing eagerly.
While Mom went to the pen, Pipo stood on tiptoe and quietly took cheese from the shelf. One piece, another, munch, munch. "Just this more, just this more..." Soon half the cheese remained.
At dinner, Mom set down a whole bowl of warm food. But his tummy was already full and heavy. "Mmm, I cannot eat a bite." Before the bowl, he lowered his head.
Mom rested a hand on his belly, rubbing circles. "You filled up with cheese, leaving no room for dinner." Tears filled his eyes. "I want dinner..."
Mom said, "Your tummy is a little shed. Fill it with cheese, and dinner cannot come in." Pipo pictured cheese to the roof, a dinner bowl outside the door. "I must leave room!"
"Leave this much space inside for dinner." Mom held two fingers a little apart. "One piece of cheese, a whole bowl of dinner!" Pipo copied the little space. "This much!"
The next day, Mom cut cheese the size of a fingernail. Pipo ate just that much and stopped. He did not even look at the shelf. "One piece of cheese, a whole bowl of dinner!" Hard, but he did it.
As sheep entered the pen, Pipo's tummy rumbled. He ate the whole bowl. "Wow, did dinner always taste this good?" Hopping off the chair, he crouched with hands at his chest.
By the shelf, Pipo dusted both hands and recited, "One, only one piece of cheese! Two, dinner first, cheese later! Three, the shelf only when Mom opens it!" The shelf cheese stayed as it was.
Mom sat Pipo on her lap and hugged him. "A wonderful puppy who knows how to wait!" A little snack made dinner tastier. Patting his belly, he said, "One piece of cheese, a whole bowl of dinner!"
